articles.title: Four American tourists among 6 killed after explosion levels building near Athens’ Acropolis - Fox News
articles.description: A suspected gas leak caused an explosions that leveled a residential building in Athens' Plaka district near the Acropolis, killing four American tourists and two residents.
articles.content:
Four American tourists were among six people killed in Greece when a devastating explosion leveled a residential building near Athens famed Acropolis, according to officials.
